title: My Family
summary: Two classmates talk about their families: how many brothers and sisters they have, and what their parents do.
description: A short beginner dialogue where two students describe their families. The vocabulary focuses on family members and basic present-simple verbs (have, work, live).

vocabulary.definition: a boy who has the same parents as you
a girl who has the same parents as you
the place where your home is

dialogue.text: Do you have a big family, Maria?
Yes, I do. I have two brothers and one sister.
Wow! Do your brothers go to school?
Yes. My brother Tom is ten, and my brother Sam is seven. My sister is five.
That's nice. I have one brother. His name is Peter.
He is twelve. We live with our parents in a small town.

questions.q: How many brothers does Maria have?

trueFalse.statement: Maria has one brother and one sister.
trueFalse.explanation: Maria has two brothers and one sister.

trueFalse.statement: The speaker lives with his parents.
trueFalse.explanation: At the end of the dialogue the speaker says 'We live with our parents.'

teacherTips: Pre-teach the question 'How old is…?' — students often confuse 'How old are you?' with 'How many years do you have?'
After listening, ask learners to draw a simple family tree and describe it to a partner.
Use this dialogue as a model for the present simple affirmative and 'have got' structures.

es.title: Mi familia
es.summary: Dos compañeros hablan de sus familias: cuántos hermanos tienen y a qué se dedican sus padres.
es.description: Un diálogo breve para principiantes en el que dos estudiantes describen a sus familias. El vocabulario se centra en miembros de la familia y verbos básicos en presente simple (have, work, live).

vocabulary.definition: un chico que tiene los mismos padres que tú
una chica que tiene los mismos padres que tú
tu madre y tu padre juntos
el lugar donde está tu casa

questions.q: ¿Cuántos años tiene la hermana de Maria?

trueFalse.statement: Maria tiene un hermano y una hermana.
trueFalse.explanation: Maria tiene dos hermanos y una hermana.

trueFalse.statement: El interlocutor vive con sus padres.
trueFalse.explanation: Al final del diálogo el interlocutor dice 'We live with our parents'.

teacherTips: Enseña primero la pregunta 'How old is…?' — los estudiantes suelen confundir 'How old are you?' con 'How many years do you have?'.
Después de escuchar, pide a los estudiantes que dibujen un árbol familiar sencillo y lo describan a un compañero.
Usa este diálogo como modelo del presente simple afirmativo y de las estructuras con 'have got'.
